label: Tax Preparation Organization Team
blurb: A Tax Organization Lead and 4 specialists who prepare organized records and questions for the user’s tax preparer
purpose: Created for individuals, families, and organizers looking for dedicated support with tax preparation organization. Prepare organized records and questions for the user’s tax preparer. The team takes care of preparation, detailed planning, and practical follow-through to keep everything running smoothly.

project.name: Tax Preparation Organization
project.goal: Deliver a comprehensive initial tax preparation organization plan with clear milestones, assigned responsibilities, and verified outputs.
